name: Alena's New Life
source: Alena has turned 18 and she decided to run away from home! There will be an adventure awaiting her in the new town; she will make new friends, as well as enemies, and she will discover new places and experiences.​
translation: Alena满18岁后，决定离家出走！新城镇正等待着她展开一段冒险；她会结交新朋友，也会遇上敌人，并发现新的地方与体验。
